SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.0: I've seen scarier things at the bottom of a cereal bowl.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.1: Did you skip the tutorial, or just fail it?
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.2: Your strategy has more holes than my socks.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.3: I've had tougher fights with a pickle jar.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.4: You're the reason shampoo has instructions.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.5: Even your shadow is trying to leave.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.6: I'd call you a worthy foe, but I don't like lying.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.7: You have all the menace of a damp sponge.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.8: My grandma hits harder, and she's knitting.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.9: Were you assembled without the manual?
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.10: You're about as threatening as a screensaver.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.11: I've met traffic cones with more presence.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.12: Is that your battle stance, or are you lost?
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.13: You smell like a dungeon that gave up.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.14: Your aim is so bad you'd miss the floor.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.15: Somewhere, a village is missing its idiot.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.16: You're one loading screen away from irrelevance.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.17: I've seen better moves from a parked car.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.18: That face could curdle a smoothie.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.19: You're not a boss. You're a speed bump.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.20: Did your armor come free in a cereal box?
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.21: Even the slimes think you're slow.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.22: You're proof that evolution takes coffee breaks.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.23: I'd explain it to you, but I left my crayons at home.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.24: You're the patch notes nobody reads.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.25: I've had scarier encounters in a ball pit.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.26: Your roar sounds like a squeaky shopping cart.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.27: You're the lag spike in my otherwise perfect day.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.28: Bold of you to show up looking like that.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.29: You'd lose a staring contest with a rock.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.31: I've fought dust bunnies with more spirit.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.32: Your battle cry needs a battle cry.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.33: Are you the final boss of disappointment?
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.34: You're like a pop-up ad: loud, ugly, and easy to close.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.35: I'd insult your intelligence, but I can't find it.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.36: Your health bar is the most interesting thing about you.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.37: You hit like a wet noodle with stage fright.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.38: I've seen more danger in a kiddie pool.
SPIREBROTHERS-INSULT_LINES.39: Take notes. This is what winning looks like.
